what: acceptance-public-surfaces allows an integration test to drive a public library function besides the CLI, HTTP or UI.
why: Owner rule after the Fieldnote run (Tom, 2026-10-20, PR #54): integration tests may enter through a public library function, e.g. Fieldnote's build_context(); end-to-end tests and just qc still go through the CLI, HTTP or UI. ADR 0002 was rewritten in place and the spec followed it (owner yes: Tom, 2026-10-20).
evidence: Fieldnote run: a target whose public surface is a library function could not be integration-tested under 'the test drives the app's CLI, HTTP or UI and calls no internal function', which contradicted rewritten ADR 0002.
